baseline_models.focus_anchor: The negated plural verb at 68:18 is the sole rooted focus anchor, ث ن ي.
baseline_models.mechanism: Exception names a part again in order to remove it from a governing whole; negating that operation leaves the undertaking closed over its whole range.

activation_trace.role: The speech-and-transaction branch supplies the literal operation of carving a stated part out of a whole, here negated.

changed_reading.before: They do not make an exception.
changed_reading.after: They leave a totalizing undertaking closed, with no part, person, or condition reserved.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same ث ن ي form can retain the root's material motion of folding, restraining, and turning aside.
baseline_models.mechanism: The negation cancels a bend or check in an adopted course, so the line can describe practical inflexibility as well as missing verbal qualification.

activation_trace.role: Folding, restraining, and turning aside provide the process image for a check that the negation refuses.

changed_reading.after: They do not bend, hold back, or redirect the course they have adopted.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: ث ن ي also carries recurrence and the addition of a second unit.
baseline_models.mechanism: An exception can be pictured as returning to a first statement for a second, differentiating mention; negation then suppresses reconsideration or a second pass.

activation_trace.role: Repetition supplies the return to an already formed decision that does not occur.
Adding a second to a first supplies the differentiating second consideration denied by the negation.

changed_reading.after: They never reopen the first resolve to a second consideration.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context turns an abstract exception into distributive architecture: goods can be withheld, a crop can be partitioned, and a poor claimant can be barred from entry. The missing exception is therefore a missing protected share or admission.

activation_trace.role: Exclusion of a part from a whole becomes the formal slot in which a share or claimant could have been reserved.
Withholding the hand from giving supplies the ethical polarity that the focus story later enacts.
Partitioning a thing into allotted portions makes the harvest a divisible whole rather than an undifferentiated possession.
Entry supplies the access relation that their closed plan explicitly denies.
The abasement of poverty identifies the excluded claimant whose admission would have qualified the whole.

structural_cues: 68:17-18 joins an oath to the negated exception, while 68:24 later states the intended admission ban and resolves what the closed whole excludes.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies withholding, partition, entry, and poverty; I supply the arrow that a verbal exception would function as a reserved claimant or share. A contingency formula rather than a distributive reservation remains a live alternative.

changed_reading.before: No unspecified part is removed from a general undertaking.
changed_reading.after: They deliberately leave no protected portion and no opening through which the poor can become a claimant on the harvest.

context_deltas.mechanism: A semantic cut is refused inside a whole just as a physical cut is intended; the object then appears wholly severed and the cutters become deprived. The sequence supports a reversal in which an unbounded cut rebounds on both crop and cutters.

activation_trace.role: Exception supplies the absent semantic cut that would have limited the whole.
Enclosure and completeness sharpen the danger of an undertaking allowed to cover every part.
Cutting and separation supply the intended harvest action that the missing exception fails to bound.
The repeated severance image relocates cutting from their controlled action to the state of the entire garden.
Loss of the desired yield completes the reversal by placing the would-be cutters outside the benefit.

structural_cues: The ordered run is oath and intended cutting at 68:17, no exception at 68:18, external visitation at 68:19, total severance at 68:20, and deprivation at 68:27.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies whole, cut, repeated severance, and deprivation; I supply the chiastic arrow that the refused limiting cut returns as an unlimited cut. Mere lexical and narrative juxtaposition remains possible.

changed_reading.before: They fail to qualify their intended harvest.
changed_reading.after: By admitting no limiting cut within their plan, they expose the whole plan to a cut that consumes its object and excludes them from its yield.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus negates inward restraint while the surrounding action intensifies outward restraint: they set off without impediment, intent on prevention, and imagine themselves able to carry it through. Refusing to hold themselves back enables them to hold good back from another.

activation_trace.role: Restraint and turning aside supply the inward check cancelled by the focus negation.
Withholding the hand from giving supplies the outward restraint produced by their unchecked course.
Unimpeded departure gives kinetic form to the absence of an internal brake.
Prevention and contraction identify the restrictive purpose toward which the unchecked movement is directed.
Imagined capacity supplies their confidence that the restrictive purpose can be completed.

structural_cues: 68:23-25 moves continuously from secret departure to restrictive intent and confidence in capacity.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies unimpeded motion, withholding, contraction, and capacity; I supply the polarity reversal that lack of self-restraint causes restraint of another's access. The ordinary speech-exception reading remains sufficient without this ethical arrow.

changed_reading.before: They do not bend their plan.
changed_reading.after: They refuse the self-check that would interrupt their movement toward depriving someone else.

context_deltas.mechanism: The trial reveals disposition, whispered speech closes the plan within the group, and only the middle voice retrospectively supplies the missing pause. The recurrence branch of ث ن ي becomes a failure to run deliberation twice.

activation_trace.role: Repetition supplies a second deliberative pass that the negation removes.
Testing that reveals a condition makes the closed decision diagnostic of disposition, not merely phrasing.
Lowered secret speech depicts a closed feedback loop that reinforces rather than reopens the plan.
The just and choice middle position supplies the corrective perspective omitted from the first resolve.
Tarrying before action supplies, retrospectively, the pause that could have hosted reconsideration.

structural_cues: The corrective speech appears only after recognition of loss, so the sequence contrasts absent prior reconsideration with abundant retrospective blame.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a revealing test, secrecy, a just middle speaker, and a pause-before-action image; I supply the arrow that a second pass could have admitted correction. The focus may still concern only an oath qualification.

changed_reading.before: They fail to add a second mention to their statement.
changed_reading.after: They fail to revisit a unanimous first resolve until consequence forces belated reconsideration.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated oath imagery and a later fantasy of binding oaths frame the focus as a speech act about the future. Sovereign intervention while the planners sleep changes the omitted exception into a missing acknowledgment that future agency is not theirs alone.

activation_trace.role: Exception in speech and oath supplies a condition capable of qualifying an absolute future claim.
Oath-taking establishes a wider speech-act motif before the garden oath appears.
The oath branch identifies the immediate undertaking that the focus leaves unqualified.
Sovereignty supplies the external agency that interrupts the self-guaranteed future while the speakers sleep.
The later oath branch repeats the imagined guarantee and exposes its absolutizing logic.
Reaching an endpoint stretches that imagined guarantee across the whole promised duration.

structural_cues: The planners bind a next-morning act at 68:17, but 68:19 inserts another agency during their sleep; 68:39 later questions supposedly far-reaching oaths.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies oaths, an unqualified future act, sovereign interruption, and a later absolute guarantee; I supply the arrow that the missing exception would acknowledge contingency beyond the speakers. Reserving a human share rather than naming contingency remains equally live.

changed_reading.before: They reserve no part of what they intend to take.
changed_reading.after: They speak the future as self-owned and unconditional, leaving no verbal opening for agency beyond themselves.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus root's unbending image becomes bodily and ethical when the later sequence presents a call to bow, inability, and remembered prior wholeness. The refused bend at 68:18 can foreshadow a capacity for bending that is later unavailable.

activation_trace.role: Bending and turning supply the bodily-ethical flexibility negated in the focus.
Capacity supplies the later explicit inability that converts disposition into consequence.
Bowing the head supplies the concrete bend that the later subjects cannot perform.
Former soundness marks the lost condition in which bending remained possible.

structural_cues: The later pair 68:42-43 explicitly contrasts present inability to bow with an earlier state of sound capacity.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies bending in the focus inventory and later bowing, incapacity, and former soundness; I supply the diachronic arrow from moral rigidity to embodied incapacity. The later scene may be independent rather than a replay of 68:18.

changed_reading.before: They will not turn aside from one plan.
changed_reading.after: Their refusal of a merciful bend is an early instance of the rigidity later rendered as inability to bow.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later counterfactual presents beneficence catching someone before an otherwise expected casting-out. That supplies a positive model of exception as an intercepting mercy, making 68:18 the refusal to let such an interruption enter their own action.

activation_trace.role: Exception supplies a local release from an otherwise governing whole or consequence.
Beneficent good condition supplies the merciful factor in the later counterfactual interruption.
Catching and reaching supply the interceptive motion that arrives before consequence completes.
Casting away supplies the otherwise expected outcome from which the intercept creates an exception.

structural_cues: The explicit counterfactual construction at 68:49 places a catching benefit between a person and an otherwise ensuing expulsion.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies beneficence, interception, expulsion, and counterfactual order; I supply the analogy that this is a mercy-shaped exception and that 68:18 refuses its human analogue. The later counterfactual may function only in its own episode.

changed_reading.before: They include no exception in an undertaking.
changed_reading.after: They permit no mercy-shaped interruption to catch their action before exclusion becomes consequence.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it transfers the focus from speech into documentary form. It remains anchored in the focus branches for legal exception and folded writing, reinforced by the surah's pen, line, and binding-book imagery. Downstream prose should present it only as an 'as if written' analogy, not as a lexical translation of the verb.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus root joins exception in binding speech with folding that can include a written object.

activation_trace.role: The legal-clause image anchors a qualification that could be inserted into or omitted from a binding text.
Folding supplies the material document image and an inward place where a qualification might be carried.
The prepared writing instrument opens the documentary frame.
The ordered written line supplies a surface on which a closed or qualified claim can be imagined.
Writing that establishes a binding rule turns the omitted qualification into a closed decree analogy.
The unseen object sharpens the presumption involved in authoring a future whose conditions remain hidden.

changed_reading.after: They behave as though authoring the unseen future into a closed document with no qualifying line.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a form-distant material analogy: the focus branch is literally a doubled cord or rein, while the context supplies release, prevention, and a binding of ends. It remains focus-anchored but should be rendered as a secondary image of 'no second tether or brake,' never as the direct dictionary sense of the focus form.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The ث ن ي inventory includes a doubled, two-ended cord or rein.

activation_trace.role: The doubled rein supplies a material model of a second restraint absent from the plan.
Release from restraint supplies the movement of an intention running without its second tether.
Prevention supplies the hard directional pull that the missing rein would have checked.
A tie gathering the ends supplies a later counter-image of held-together restraint.

changed_reading.after: Their intention runs under one hard pull with no second rein capable of checking it.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it moves from numerical seconding to social inclusion. It remains anchored in the focus branch that makes two by adding one, the explicit barred entry of a poor person, and the later breakup into mutually facing parts. Downstream prose should qualify it as a social-number analogy rather than claim that the verb itself means admitting another person.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus root can picture making two by adding a second to a first.

activation_trace.role: Adding a second supplies the social possibility of admitting another claimant beside the owning group.
Entry gives concrete form to whether another party can join the owners' closed field of benefit.
Poverty identifies the prospective second claimant whom the group refuses to admit.
Partition into some and some shows the formerly closed collective reappearing as differentiated parts after loss.
A group turning face-to-face supplies the social doubling that arrives only as reciprocal accusation.

changed_reading.before: They add no exception to the owners' plan.
changed_reading.after: The closed 'we' refuses to become two by admitting another claimant, then fractures into parts facing one another after the loss.

strongest_changes: The generic exception became a protected share and an admission point for a poor claimant.
The refused semantic cut was reversed into a total severance that deprived the intended cutters.
The negation acquired a polarity: no self-restraint enables maximal restraint of another's access.
Later oath, bowing, and counterfactual-interception scenes kept contingency, rigidity, and mercy-shaped exception simultaneously live.
summary.what_was_special: A single focus root supported exact legal exclusion, bending, recurrence, doubling, and a doubled rein. Ordered context did not collapse these into one answer: it made the same short line distributive, causal, deliberative, bodily, covenantal, and interceptive by turns.
remaining_uncertainties: The immediate omitted exception may reserve a human share, acknowledge external contingency, or deliberately carry both functions.
The rebound from semantic cut to total severance is strongly sequenced but its causal direction remains reader-supplied.
The documentary, rein, social-seconding, and later-bowing activations are branch-anchored yet form-distant and require explicit qualification.
